name: Leafborn
description:
About This Game

Leafborn is a fast-paced action game that puts you in command of a being made of thousands of leaves. Discover new forms and abilities throughout the universe of Canopy, filled with floating islands, and fight Nulls, invading robots that have come to drain this world of its life energy.

Shapeshift and Rewrite the Rules

Your character can take on different forms, and every ability behaves differently depending on your current form. Become a tornado that sends enemies flying or a saw that cuts straight through them. Combine forms and abilities to create your own playstyle.

Choose, Strike, Survive

Survival comes not from defense but from offense. Victory belongs to those who move fast, read the enemy's moves, and use their forms and abilities in the right combinations.

A New Horizon Every Run

Glide between floating islands as you face increasingly vicious robots. Every run starts from scratch, but your progress is permanent. Use the upgrades you earn between runs to unlock new forms and abilities, expand the loot pool, and reach unexplored routes across Canopy.

Key Features

  • Command a shapeshifting swarm of more than 10,000 leaves

  • Jump, shapeshift, and glide with your fluid body of leaves

  • Discover new forms and transform into them

  • Tear invading robots apart

  • A fast-paced, action-packed 3D roguelite
short_desc: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!
